metadata.title: GM earnings & outlook impressed, thanks to lower tariffs. But don't get too comfortable.

content.text:
00:00 Speaker A
General Motors, um the company raising its forecast, thank you. Um by $500 million dollars, um saw lower tariffs, um which was good for the company, um and uh better margins on its largest vehicles. So, that helping things here. Even though as you point out, it's not, I mean, it's not like the car market here is good.
00:26 Speaker B
Yeah.
00:26 Speaker A
It's just, you know, it seems like the best we can hope for is sort of not as bad as expected. I mean, and they are, they're making money.
00:35 Speaker B
Right. They beat on top and bottom line, but they came out and announced they're still on a loss on their EVs. That is still not the market they probably wanted it to be. They're selling less they're making more money but they're selling less cars, just trying to drive higher margins.
00:54 Speaker B
But at some point you have to ask, we saw the EV market pull back. Can there be a return to form? Can Tesla come back? Can this market really start opening up again? Or are we now seating that back and kind of forgetting that in at least for the next few years?
01:09 Speaker C
But you also have to factor in oil prices are higher too, right? So how long do we stay with higher oil prices? I think that's got to be a big catalyst. Maybe not just here but especially in Europe where of course they're energy uh dependent. Um I can see that push towards electric vehicles um you know, being a much faster migration. But also like besides Tesla, we don't have great EVs here.
01:31 Speaker C
And overall, it's not a great market. Like there's no EV I really think is like, wow, that's amazing that America makes. And I think that's another problem. So maybe if you get some more competition and you get some some better cars out there that like you actually want to drive. I think that would also be a big catalyst towards EVs.
01:42 Speaker A
And then the other thing is that that, you know, again, they got the tariff boost, but you know, who knows how long that's going to last. We got these, you know, now new tariffs on Canada that don't affect autos specifically, but it's just sort of a reminder that like, don't get too comfortable because you could have some new tariffs coming and you know, so the companies um can sort of benefit from this tariff reprieve while they can.
